errors_encountered.error: CS5001 'Program does not contain a static Main method suitable for an entry point' + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter given during MarkupCompilePass2' + WMC9999 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object' (Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Markup.Compiler)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The .csproj <DefineConstants> included DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN with no hand-written Program.cs/Main. That suppresses the SDK's auto-generated App.g.i.cs Main; MarkupCompilePass2 then runs without a LocalAssembly (WMC1509), crashes with WMC9999, and no Main is emitted (CS5001). Reproduced deterministically: adding only that constant to a clean `dotnet new winui` scaffold produces all three messages; removing it fixes the build.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN from <DefineConstants> (let the SDK generate Main), or add a Program.cs with [STAThread] static void Main calling Application.Start.
